The '''Ord Janon system''' was located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Spinward sector/Legends|Spinward sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Janon]].<ref name="CSWE" />

At some point no earlier than the [[Pius Dea Era]],<ref name="Ord">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' indicates that [[Planet/Legends|planets]] having "Ord" as part of their names served as [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Colonist/Legends|outposts]] known as [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depots]] beginning with the [[Pius Dea Era]].</ref> a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] that lasted between [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000]] and [[11,000 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> Ord Janon served as an [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]] [[Colonist/Legends|outpost]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Ord" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] that were waged between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="TEA" /> the planet was occupied by [[Confederacy military/Legends|Confederate forces]].<ref name="CSWE" />

Following a successful [[Battle of Birgis|invasion]] of the [[Birgis system/Legends|Birgis system]] at some point between [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] and [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], the Ord Janon [[Star system/Legends|system]] was [[Attack on the Ord Janon system|attacked]] by the military forces of the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]] as part of their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|conquest]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The [[Star/Legends|star]] system was still under the [[Yuuzhan Vong empire|control]] of those invaders by [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ord Janon system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]] and which placed it in grid square N-2.<ref name="TEA" />
